hypothesis: A trainable multiplicative interaction of a frozen factual fifth-action binder score difference and a separately learned B-history gate can recover counterfactual-sign reversal from factual action outcomes; the Native backbone must independently add decision value against fully trained conventional history controls, not merely preserve binder predictions.
motivating_observation: R41 adds frozen binder and learned recurrent scalar outputs; training produces no B gate decision flips despite positive fitted factual control. Binding-gradient dominance and missing learned interaction are candidate mechanisms only, NOT established causes.

source.fifth_probe: Reuse R41 exactly selected fifth probe protocol and public context/fifth factual effect generation; the hidden gate must not influence any early/fifth selected observation.

b_history.marker_position: FIT 1+(group%4); DEV 1+((3*group+1)%5); OOD 2+((5*group+1)%11); do not provide marker index to model.
b_history.marker_effect: nuisance+0.24*hidden_gate at marker; nuisance alone elsewhere

physics.fifth: Existing R41 R33 quartic selected-fifth physical law with evaluator-only q_sign and no gate.
physics.return_fit_dev: Existing R41 quartic return law with effective_q=q_sign*q_magnitude*hidden_gate
physics.return_ood: Existing R41 early-null cubic amended return law with effective_q=q_sign*q_magnitude*hidden_gate
physics.loss: Squared distance from physical goal 1.0 computed from each actually selected factual return effect.

learner.frozen_binder: Exact qualified R39 R38 TrainableBinding with original 512 factual pretraining updates per seed 985201 and 985207; binder weights/decision fingerprint immutable during R42.
learner.interface: Compute two preaction candidate scores from same frozen binder and causal history (all selected current return effects masked). Define binder contrast b1-b0. Train a gate from PUBLIC history only; output candidate pair score contrast = (b1-b0)*tanh(gate(history)). No hidden gate sign, marker index, physical law, or explicit target sign inside model. Ensure gates are learned, not formula-derived. The same gate implementation is used for native and conventional arms.
learner.native_mechanism: Native arm history gate must genuinely consume an original R34 native backbone output in addition to recurrent history encoding; backbone ablation must change measured actions, not just changed weights.
prereg_negative_controls: erase selected B marker before model
swap only B marker within matched opposite-gate pair
zero Native backbone with learned history and fusion intact
zero binder contrast while keeping gate
learner.conventional_positive_control: Fit calibration and B marker sign only from selected FIT factual measurements, score on untouched DEV/OOD, label as hand-engineered diagnostic; not proof of learned neural success.
learner.parameter_compute_matching: Measure trainable parameter counts, actual CPU runtime and backbone forward FLOPs where possible. Stronger/more-compute conventional controls remain fully trained. If exact matched compute/params is unachievable, mark strict native-vs-conventional science UNVERIFIED; do not call model comparison compute-matched.
learner.seed_rule: No post-score seed replacement, criterion tuning, optimizer sweep or extra data reuse. Any later hypothesis is an independent prospective experiment.

interpretive_rules: If native fails any frozen test, neural native incremental claim NO-GO; preserve loss and all negatives.
If all learned gated arms recover but native fails unique backbone ablation or matched-controls gain, credit learned cross-channel interaction, NOT Native-specific intelligence.
If only hand-coded control succeeds, architecture/optimization remains NO-GO.
Even both-panel development success is synthetic only, not real world action-consequence learning, AGI, or independent scientific acceptance.
